desc:
🌀 Welcome to PORTAL DUELS!

How to Play:
⚔️ Challenge friends to Duels or battle other players
🌀 Use portals to outplay, flank, and escape your enemies
🔫 Unlock new Weapons & Attachments
💥 Collect Kill Effects
🎨 Unlock Portal Skins & Weapon Skins
🏆 Master your movement, aim, and portal strategy

Controls:
🖥️ PC
Open Portal — E
Close Portals — Q
Use Gadget — F

📱 Mobile — On-screen Portal, Close & Gadget buttons
🎮 Console — Controller Portal, Close & Gadget buttons

🔥 Portal meets Rivals — aim better, think faster, and outplay everyone.
